clips.title: The story
paras: Forsaken apothecaries at Tarren Mill brew the Elixir of Pain for dangerous experiments. The mixture tests biological agents meant to advance Lady Sylvanas's darker ambitions.

The Royal Apothecary Society seeks formulas to strengthen the Forsaken against their mortal neighbors and the Scourge. The Elixir of Pain is one such trial, made with freshly harvested ingredients from around the Hillsbrad Foothills. Its living subjects matter little to its makers; the potion tests volatile substances meant to aid the Dark Lady.
